description: The delegation cases of spec RFC 0030's amendment, copied from the specification's conformance/delegation/, not regenerated: the statement cases (conformance tables 1 and 2, and the row ed25519-unchanged) and the admission read cases (tables 4 and 5, section 2a, and read-v2-binding-step-12). Each copy is that file's bytes unchanged, and each sha256 is the one the specification's conformance/delegation/README.md states. The ES256 statements were signed once by a generator independent of both implementations and frozen; the admission read cases are hand-written and need no signer. Both readers check each copy's SHA-256 against this citation before they read it, and read every case to its expectation.
